cases.question: What are the comprehensive statistics for accounts opened in Litomerice in 1996, including client demographics, transaction activity, loan information, and quarterly distribution of account openings?
cases.shared_initial_sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS male_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_female_clients,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A16 AS crimes_1996,
    ROUND(SUM(LOAN_AMOUNT / TOTAL_TRANSACTIONS_AMOUNT), 2) AS avg_transaction_per_loan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT L.LOAN_ID) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.STATUS = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    ROUND(SUM(T.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * CASE WHEN T.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END), 2) AS net_cash_flow,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.STATUS = 'A' THEN T.TRANSACTIONS_WITH_GOOD_LOAN ELSE NULL END) AS transactions_with_good_loan,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'VYDAJ' AND T.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT > 0 THEN 1 END) AS withdrawal_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN T.TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'PRIJEM' AND T.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT < 0 THEN 1 END) AS credit_count
FROM account A
JOIN client C ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = C.DISP_ACCOUNT_ID
JOIN disp D ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = D.ACCOUNT_ID
JOIN district DTR ON A.DISTRICT_ID = DTR.DISTRICT_ID
LEFT JOIN loan L ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = L.ACCOUNT_ID AND L.STATUS = 'A'
LEFT JOIN trans T ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = T.ACCOUNT_ID AND L.LOAN_ID IS NOT NULL AND L.STATUS = 'A'
WHERE 
    DTR.DISTRICT_A2 = 'Litomerice' AND 
    STRFTIME('%Y', A.DATE) = '1996' AND 
    A.FREQUENCY = 'quarterly'
GROUP BY 
    C.GENDER, 
    DTR.A4, 
    DTR.A11, 
    DTR.A16;
